Its exit tail-calls another routine, so the logical return type and any meaningful parameter cannot be inferred from this wrapper/caller evidence. Do not keep the candidate void*(context) signature on current evidence.

At the indexed call site x0 is explicitly set to 16 or 17 and x1 receives x20; the body uses x0 in control/count logic and x1 as an address-bearing value in the candidate-list traversal. It returns a value the caller compares with 1 and stores as a 32-bit result. The candidate's workspace/output parameter interpretations are unsupported; this is a conservative register-level shape with no asserted pointee type.

The indexed caller allocates an object, passes the returned address in x0, then stores that same address independently after the call. The body directly initializes multiple fields at constant offsets from x0 and the caller ignores the returned x0, supporting a void initializer with one generic object pointer. No concrete pointee type or field types are implied by this prototype.
